title: Setup completion check: real mission + prerequisite reporting (VC-201-069)
goal: VC-201-069 refuted: apply() runs no mission and reports no missing prerequisites — the completion check is a list of filesystem mutations; cloud_opt_in applies with keys_present empty (missing prerequisite neither checked nor reported); default_config writes a bare {} not bundled defaults; susi-native is listed without an availability check; the plan has no tools or policy steps. Evidence: crates/susi-config/src/tests/vc_201_069_mastery.rs.
